name: confirmation-stall-is-bounded
pins: Stall containment. Non-answers in pending_confirmation are legal self-stays, but the re-ask loop is bounded: at the cap (3) the re-ask stops being LLM-worded and becomes a code template, costing no further model wording. The stall never resolves implicitly in either direction — no auto-commit and no auto-decline — so after five non-answers the run is still waiting, the proposal is still live, and nothing has been booked.
